easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rhovanion Rampager, adding {C}{C}.
When Rhovanion Rampager dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Rhovanion Rampager trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Rhovanion Rampager from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
